rounds: I’d rather work for a start-up than for a big company.
Getting rich quickly is always a bit suspicious.
It’s fine to borrow money to invest.
Crypto will still be around in twenty years.
Insider trading should be punished as harshly as stealing.
Bosses’ pay should be limited to twenty times the average worker’s.
I’d rather have a safe job than a small chance of getting very rich.
Cash will have disappeared from German shops within ten years.
